0022600036.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers (5-6, 7th in the East, 2nd in the Central and 2.5 games back) visit the Miami Heat (5-6, 8th in the East, 1.5 games back in the Southeast) in the Cavaliers' 13th game of the season, an Emirates NBA Cup East Group B matchup. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, split their 2025-26 series 2-2, and Cleveland won the last meeting 149-128 in Cleveland on March 27, 2026. Sam Merrill is out for Cleveland with an elbow injury, and he is averaging 7.7 points and 23.1 minutes per game this season after 12.8 points and 26.5 minutes last season.
